description: Offers a visual overhaul of character portraits, featuring edited vanilla assets with improved lighting and clarity alongside new semi-realistic portraits. The pack expands the available character pool while maintaining consistency with the vanilla art style, focusing on lighting, proportions, and art direction without any gameplay changes.
